summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily share repurchases under its existing buy-back programme announced on 30 July 2026. On 03 August 2026, Shell purchased 1,025,000 shares on LSE and Chi-X at a volume-weighted average price of GBP 33.6723, and on 04 August 2026, it bought 1,100,000 shares, with repurchases also on XAMS. The buys are for cancellation, executed by Goldman Sachs International independently until 23 October 2026, within pre-set parameters and under UK/EU MAR rules. This is a routine capital return disclosure.
